results.persona: Pedro: keyboard only, deuteranopia (CDP deuteranopia emulation), 125% zoom on 1280×800 (1024×560 CSS, DSF 2.5), prefers-reduced-motion
results.summary: Joguei cerca de 54 minutos só com o teclado, com as cores de deuteranopia. Fiz a nova campanha (Recruta, base em Itália) e a base (investigação, pessoal, construção, mercado). Depois vieram a interceção, uma derrota num OVNI aterrado ao crepúsculo e uma vitória num OVNI despenhado à noite. Usei o inventário, o kit médico, o relatório mensal de janeiro e as gravações, ativei a paleta «Daltonismo» e abri a Ufopédia. Comecei um ataque terrorista em fevereiro. Quase todas as correções da ronda 3 estão boas: X aborta a missão, o pânico aparece com «⚠ PÂNICO» e aria, o kit médico usa ←/→ para o ferido e ↑/↓ para a parte do corpo, e o relatório mensal desloca-se com PageDown/End. O caminho já usa ● ○ ✕ e diz «sem UT para disparar», os botões repetidos dizem a que projeto pertencem e as Opções têm tabindex móvel. Quase todo o combate se faz bem com o cursor de teclado (mover, apontar com Tab, granada G, ⌥+Enter na porta). O que mais me atrapalhou é novo: na Investigação, depois de carregar em −5/+/Todos o foco salta para «NOVO PROJETO», e o Enter seguinte abre o diálogo de novo projeto. Há outras arestas. No Mercado são 87 paragens de Tab e as setas não fazem nada. Um segundo Enter rápido em «Contratar» perde-se sem aviso. O briefing não se desloca com as setas. O registo não diz se os meus tiros acertaram. No inventário, ← e ↓ na mão esquerda ainda saltam para sítios inesperados.

findings.claim: In the base, after activating a button that has no data-act (for example the scientist stepper −5/−/+/+5/Todos in Investigação), focus jumps to «NOVO PROJETO». The next Enter opens the «Novo projeto» dialog instead of repeating the action. The same thing happens in Naves («Mudar o nome da nave», «COMPRAR NAVE») and in Soldados («Mudar o nome do soldado», armadura «NENHUMA», «DESPEDIR SOLDADO»).
findings.evidence: Base → 2 → Tab to «Retirar 5 cientistas — Kit Médico» → Enter. Focus goes to «Novo projeto», traced to focusin from refocus at base_ui.js:584. A second Enter opened the dialog with «Iniciar: Detetor de Movimento» focused. Shots: shots/019-focusjump.png and 018-resassign.png. The cause: OV.Dom.tooltip() sets data-lp="1" on every button (dom.js:254). focusKey (dom.js:77) then prefers the dataset and returns «button[data-lp="1"]», which matches 46 buttons, so refocus focuses the first one. Measured with OV.Dom.focusKey: tab 2 has 11 buttons with this generic key, tab 6 has 2 and tab 7 has 4.
findings.fix: In focusKey, ignore internal dataset keys (lp, and any key without identity), and fall back to id or aria-label when nothing else is left. Better still, give the stepper and soldier/craft buttons a stable data-act/data-topic (e.g. data-act="sci-5" data-topic="medikit"). Add a test that checks querySelectorAll(focusKey(b)).length === 1 for every button in the base.

findings.claim: The oneShot 400 ms guard also blocks keyboard activations. A second Enter pressed on purpose in «CONTRATAR +5» is lost without a sound, toast or visible sign, so the keyboard player does not know the order did not go through.
findings.evidence: Pessoal → focus «Contratar 5 soldados» → Enter, Enter (300 ms apart). Funds went from $5 020 000 to $4 820 000, which is a single order of $200 000, with no toast for the second press. Log: «base: … one Enter dropped by oneShot». Code: oneShot() at base_ui.js:95–100 uses `t - lastOnceT < 400` for any event.
findings.fix: Apply the time window only to pointer clicks (e.detail >= 1). For keyboard activation (e.detail === 0), accept every Enter. If a guard is still wanted, show a toast such as «Encomenda já feita — carregue outra vez para repetir».

findings.claim: In the Mercado, a keyboard user has to go through 87 tab stops (−, +, +10 and Comprar on every row), and ↑/↓/PageDown do nothing. Reaching Carregador de Espingarda takes about 42 Tabs and Sinalizador about 85. The Comprar/Vender toggle has no aria-pressed, so the active mode is shown only by a light background.
findings.evidence: Base → 8. Counted 87 buttons with tabIndex >= 0, Sinalizador at index 84 and the rifle at 32. ArrowDown/ArrowUp/PageDown with focus on «Comprar 1 × Espingarda» left focus where it was (no change). outerHTML of the toggle: `<button class="btn small seg on" data-mode="buy">` with no aria-pressed. Shot: shots/054-market.png.
findings.fix: Make each item row a single tab stop (roving tabindex). On the row, ←/→ change the quantity (Shift ×10), Enter buys, and ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown move between rows. Add jump keys per section (Naves, Armamento, Armas…) or type-ahead by name. Put aria-pressed (or role=radio with aria-checked) on Comprar/Vender.

findings.claim: The mission briefing has a scrolling list (the soldier cards, 244 px hidden at 1024×560), but ↓/PageDown/End do nothing while focus is on «INICIAR MISSÃO», where it starts. The only way to scroll is to find the scroll area with Tab. The debrief and the monthly report already scroll with these keys.
findings.evidence: Briefing of OVNI-2: .scr-brief-body scrollTop stays 0/244 after ArrowDown, PageDown and End. After one Tab (focus on the DIV), ArrowDown goes to 40, 80 and PageDown to 244. Shots: shots/021-brief.png and 022-brief-focusdiv.png.
findings.fix: In the briefing's keys(), call OV.Screens.ui.scrollKeys(ev, body), as the debrief and the monthly report do. Add «↑ ↓ PageDown deslocam» to the footer.

findings.claim: Ainda presente (ronda 2), em parte: the spatial navigation in the combat inventory still jumps unexpectedly. From the empty MÃO ESQUERDA, ← goes to the first belt cell (below, not to the left), and ↓ sometimes goes to the Espingarda in MÃO DIREITA (to the right) instead of the belt.
findings.evidence: Combat → I, with the keyboard focus on MÃO ESQUERDA. ArrowLeft gives «s1 cell kfocus | 20» (belt magazine). ArrowDown gives «s3 big kfocus | Espingarda 20/20». Shots: shots/070-invA-lefthand.png and 071-invB-afterDown.png. In other sequences, ↓ from the same box went to the belt. navMove (inventory_ui.js:501–535) keeps candidates that do not overlap (horiz && overlap<=4 && side>main*2.5 lets in cells further down). With ↓ the hand-to-hand order of the same zone wins over the belt below.
findings.fix: ←/→: when there is no candidate on the same row (overlap), stay where you are (or wrap) instead of going to another row. ↓: prefer candidates whose top is below the current bottom (b.top >= a.bottom - 4), and only then same-row cells. Treat both hands as one row and the belt as the row below.

findings.claim: The message log (N) and the turn summary do not record whether the X-COM shots hit or missed. The only feedback is a small red number that floats for 1 s on the map (0xff5a4a, which turns brownish under deuteranopia). After the shot I still did not know whether my 90 % shot had hit.
findings.evidence: Turn 9: Catarina fired a snap shot (Acerto ≈ 90 %) at the Sectoide at 25,2. Afterwards, the log (N) has only «Catarina Sousa foi morta em combate — tiro de Sectoide Soldado». The alien was left at hp 12 (as read from OV.Game.B) and there was no hit or miss line. logEntry (battle_ui.js:1371–1376) ignores 'damage' when !mine(u). Shots: shots/043-fired.png and 044-log.png.
findings.fix: Add entries for shots from your own soldiers: «{name} acertou em {alien} (−n)» / «{name} falhou» (one per burst, counting hits). Also show the damage number in a colour that stays visible to colour-blind players (white with a dark outline, or the cvd palette), for at least 1.5 s when reduced motion is on.

findings.claim: The state of the UT reserve buttons (Sem reserva / Tiro rápido / Apontado / Rajada / Ajoelhar) is shown only by colour (class .on, a gold outline) and has no aria-pressed. The Geoscape speed radiogroup has no aria-label/aria-labelledby, and all six radios are tab stops, unlike the radiogroups in Opções.
findings.evidence: After Shift+2: every .bs-res has aria-pressed=null, and only «Reservar tiro rápido» has class «on». Screenshot shots/072-reserve.png. Geoscape: the radiogroup «5 seg…1 dia» has aria-labelledby null and tabIndex 0 on every option.
findings.fix: Set aria-pressed=true/false (or role=radio with aria-checked inside a role=radiogroup labelled «Reserva de UT»), and give the active button a shape cue (a filled background or a ✓). In the Geoscape, use aria-label="Velocidade do tempo" and a roving tabindex, as in Opções.

findings.claim: Ainda presente (ronda 3), em parte: when you centre on an alien with «1» in the city (Local de terror), the alien stands behind a building wall and is completely hidden. Only a yellowish smudge on the ground shows it. Under deuteranopia that smudge looks like the gold/yellow markers of my own soldiers, so I could not tell what, or where, the «1» was.
findings.evidence: Terror mission, Caracas, turn 1. A Reaper is at 22,13, and the HUD shows «1». Pressing 1 and then ← for the cursor shows only a yellow blob behind the wall, with the path ✕ marks over the wall. Shot: shots/100-alien-cvd4.png (with the «Daltonismo» palette on).
findings.fix: Draw an always-visible silhouette or outline of visible aliens through walls (an x-ray outline in the hostile shape, such as a diamond), or cut away the walls between the camera and the centred alien or cursor. On centring with 1–0, show a label with the alien's name or type next to the marker.

delights: The tile cursor in combat is good: Enter walks, Tab cycles aliens while aiming, ⌥+Enter opened the UFO door and G and L work. With it I could play a whole mission without the mouse.
The path preview is readable without colour: ● for steps that keep a shot, ○ where firing is no longer possible, ✕ out of reach, plus the label «sem UT para disparar».
Panic is now clear: «⚠ PÂNICO» on the squad list, an aria-label and the turn summary «3 em pânico» with a MOSTRAR button for each.
X aborts the mission with a confirmation that explains the cost (ship lost, −200).
The kit médico finally makes sense: ←/→ patient, ↑/↓ body part, 1/2/3 for actions, with the help line at the bottom.
The monthly report and the debrief scroll with PageDown/End, and «Vitória cara — dica para a próxima» helps.
Opções has an Acessibilidade section (Daltonismo palette, keyboard cursor, reduce motion, text size) with radiogroups using a roving tabindex.
The interception plays well from the keyboard: 1–5 set the stance, Q/E switch weapons, and the text is clear.
The repeated buttons now have useful names: «Atribuir mais 1 cientista — Kit Médico», «Gravar: Posição 1», «Exportar: Automática».

results.persona: Marta, a touch-only player on an iPad Pro 11" in Safari, emulated with Playwright (hasTouch, isMobile, DPR 2, 1194×834 landscape and 834×1194 portrait). Session lasted about 75 minutes in real time. She played a Recruta campaign: base Sintra (Lisbon); base management in portrait (build, hire, Market Buy/Sell, rename by virtual keyboard, Ufopédia, Financiamento, Gravar); Medium Scout mission (day, landscape); Large Scout mission (night → «Esperar pelo dia», played in portrait). To reach the 1 Feb month report she skipped ahead by OK-ing the remaining January events. She then played one Quick Battle at an Alien Base (10 soldiers, Recruta), in landscape and portrait, and aborted it at turn 8.
results.summary:
Round 4 on the iPad is a clear step up. Almost all of my findings from earlier rounds are fixed:
- In portrait, the reserve buttons get their own row.
- A long press on a HUD button shows its name.
- Pinch zoom on the globe stays at the limit.
- The Equipar screen works in portrait.
- In portrait, the Ufopédia and Financiamento lay out in one column.
- The date shows in the base header in portrait.
- Rows in the Soldados tab are 37 px tall.
- «Return» on the keyboard only closes the keyboard.
- There are no 1/2/3 key badges on the difficulty cards.
- «Toque para acelerar» shows during the alien turn.
- «Esperar pelo dia» now arrives in «Dia».

I could play everything by touch only, with no accidental page zoom or scroll, and every load took 3–4 s.

What still bothers me:
- In close combat, tapping an alien standing just behind my own soldier aims at my soldier («Ação impossível»).
- In portrait the base keeps the facility grid on every tab, so the Market or a soldier's card sits in a small 520 px box, and the soldier card appears off-screen.
- In portrait you can't drag from the Armazém, because the list scrolls instead.
- «Esperar pelo dia» leaves time at «5 seg», so I watched the globe for over two minutes.
- A few small texts: a repeated paragraph, «51.2/50» with a decimal point, and mouse-only options shown on the iPad.

Two-finger panning at zoom 2 in combat still drops the zoom now and then.

findings.claim: In aim mode, tapping an alien that stands right behind the active soldier (one tile up-screen, e.g. adjacent inside the UFO) selects the soldier's own tile. The label shows «Ação impossível». Only a strip about 10 px tall at the top of the alien's head hits it. Tapping the red alien button «1» in aim mode only moves the camera; it does not aim. So in close combat by touch you have to hunt for the exact pixel.
findings.evidence: Campaign mission 1 (Medium Scout, Portugal), turn 8. Rajesh at (14,28) aims his pistol at the Sectoid at (13,27). A tap at the alien's centre (OV.BattleUI.debug.unitScreen → 149,490) gives target.label «Ação impossível» with the red reticle on Rajesh himself. Tap at 148,455: «Sem linha de tiro — alguém no caminho» (tile 11,25). Tap at 149,470: «Acerto ≈ 79 %». In a second test (alien 52 at 14,27), tapping the .bs-alien button in aim mode left target:null and only centred the camera. Shots: persona/r4/ipad/shots/061_rajesh_aim.png, 060_alien_behind_wall_crop.png, 063_alienbtn_in_target.png.
findings.fix: In pickAt/OV.BattleRender.pick, when S.mode is 'target' or 'throw', give priority to the rects of visible hostile units: never resolve to the selected unit's own tile when a hostile's rect, including its head and the chevron area, overlaps the touch point. Use a touch tolerance of about 20 px for hostile rects. In aim mode, a tap on the .bs-alien button should set the target on that alien (preview the shot), not just centre the camera.

findings.claim: In portrait (834×1194), the base shows the 6×6 facility grid, the selected-facility card and the stats on every tab. That takes about 780 px, so the tab content (Market, Soldiers, Research) gets only a 520 px scrolling box. In Soldiers, tapping a soldier opens the card (rename, armour, craft, dismiss) below the box's fold, nearly invisible. Nothing seems to happen until you scroll inside the small box.
findings.evidence: Base → Soldados in portrait, tap «Kenta Kato». The row is highlighted, but the card with RENOMEAR sits at y=1165 (at the bottom edge, cut off). .bsc-content scroll: clientHeight 520 / scrollHeight 905; Market: 520 / 2098. On the right of the grid there are about 330 px of empty space. Shots: persona/r4/ipad/shots/033_sold_tap_kenta.png, 031_mercado_portrait.png, 035_sold_rename.png.
findings.fix: Under @media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:900px), on tabs other than Instalações, hide or collapse the grid and the facility card (e.g. a «Ver base» button), so .bsc-content takes the full height. Or shrink the grid to about 50 % with the stats beside it. Also, when a soldier is selected in Soldados, call scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) on the card.

findings.claim: In portrait, Equipar (base and briefing) says «Toque no objeto e depois no destino, ou arraste-o com o dedo». But dragging a row from the Armazém up to a hand or the backpack only scrolls the list, even after holding 600 ms. The destinations are all above, and .inv-it.row has touch-action: pan-y. Dragging from the belt to the backpack works.
findings.evidence: Briefing → EQUIPAR in portrait. Drag from the «Pistola» row (300,866) to the left hand (179,442) with a 40 ms hold and with a 600 ms hold: MÃO ESQUERDA stays «VAZIA», Peso 20/31, and the Armazém list scrolls to the end. Drag from the belt grenade to the backpack: works (MOCHILA 1/9). Tap-then-tap works. Shots: persona/r4/ipad/shots/089_drag_mid.png, 095_drag_h600.png.
findings.fix: Start a drag on a long press: after about 300 ms without movement on an .inv-it.row, enter drag mode and call preventDefault on the following touchmove events (non-passive touchmove listener) so the list does not scroll. Show the item lifting as feedback. Or, in portrait/touch, change the hint to «toque no objeto e depois no destino (arrastar: toque longo)».

findings.claim: «Esperar pelo dia» does not speed up time. After the «Equipa no local» popup the clock is back at «5 seg», so waiting about 5 game hours takes about 5 minutes of real time with nothing to do. The toast only says «Avisamos quando amanhecer».
findings.evidence: Campaign, 6 jan 01:59, OVNI-3 in the Reino Unido. Tap ESPERAR PELO DIA. After 133 s of real time it was only 04:16 (2 h 17 min of game time), speed still «5 seg». Manually choosing «30 min» reached «AMANHECEU NO LOCAL» at 06:43 in 1.7 s. Shot: persona/r4/ipad/shots/084_dawn.png. waitForDay() (geo_ui.js about line 2481) only queues G.ui.waitDay and the toast.
findings.fix: In waitForDay, raise the clock to a fast speed (30 min or 1 hora) if it is slower, as the original does when you wait. The checkWaitDay or dawn popup already stops it. Or add a «Acelerar» button to the toast, or change the text to «…toque em 1 hora para esperar mais depressa».

findings.claim: In Recruta, the «Equipa no local» popup at night repeats the same advice twice in a row: «É noite: os alienígenas veem no escuro e os soldados não. Esperar pelo dia (cerca de 5 h)?» and then «Lá é noite: os alienígenas veem no escuro e os soldados só veem bem perto das luzes. Esperar pelo dia (cerca de 5 h) torna a missão bem mais fácil — …».
findings.evidence: Campaign, 6 jan 01:59, arrival of Águia at OVNI-3 (night). Shot: persona/r4/ipad/shots/083_arrive2.png. In geo_ui.js, line 2021 unshifts geo.ev.arrived.night(.safe) and line 2025 unshifts geo.ev.arrived.night.ask, both with the same {t}.
findings.fix: When waitDef is true (the ask line is shown), use a short variant of the second line without «Esperar pelo dia (cerca de {t})». For example 'geo.ev.arrived.night.safe.short': «Nestes primeiros meses, um OVNI que aterra de noite fica no chão até amanhecer.» Or merge the two into a single line.

findings.claim: The mission report shows the overfull storage with an English decimal point, «Armazém sobrelotado (51.2/50)». The rest of the game uses the pt-PT comma («ARMAZÉM 51,2/50» in the base and «41,7/50»).
findings.evidence: Report for mission 1 (Medium Scout), right column: «Armazém sobrelotado (51.2/50): venda material ou construa armazéns.» In the base on the same day: «ARMAZENAMENTO 51,2/50». Shot: persona/r4/ipad/shots/072_debrief_scrolled.png. campaign_ui.js:1524 passes model.storage.used (a raw number from sim/campaign.js:825) into T('cp.db.storageOver').
findings.fix: Format with the same helper as the base (e.g. OV.U.fmtNum(used, 1) or Number.toLocaleString('pt-PT', {maximumFractionDigits:1})) before interpolating {used}.

findings.claim: Still present (round 1), now intermittent. In combat at maximum zoom (2), a two-finger pan sometimes drops the zoom to 1.5 on its own. The globe no longer does this (zoom 5 held across 4 pans).
findings.evidence: Alien Base Quick Battle, landscape. In 4 batches of «pinch out to 2 → 4–5 two-finger pans (fingers 80 px apart, distance constant)», zoom dropped 2 → 1.5 in 3 of the 12 sequences tested: [2,2,1.5,…] (t55), [2,1.5,1.5,…] (t56 run 1), [2,2,2,1.5,1.5] (t57 run 1). The other sequences stayed at 2. The value always snaps to 1.5 (SNAPS via scheduleSnap), so a zoom event with factor < 1 was emitted during a pure pan. Logs: persona/r4/ipad/log.txt and the t55/t56/t57 scripts in persona/r4/ipad/.
findings.fix: Make the pinch absolute and per-gesture: keep z0 = cam.zoom and d0 from the pointerIds of the current gesture, and compute z = z0·d/d0 only after the PINCH_DEAD threshold. Clear the touches Map on pointerup/pointercancel/lostpointercapture so a lost finger is not reused. In battle_ui, cancel any pending scheduleSnap/zoomTween when a pan starts, and do not apply factor < 1 when it comes from a gesture that started at ZMAX without passing the threshold.

findings.claim: Partly still present (rounds 1–3). On the iPad the Options screen still shows mouse-only settings, «Deslocar nas margens do ecrã» and «Roda do rato: Nível/Zoom», and the text «Pede um 2.º clique…». The long-press tooltips on HUD buttons show the keyboard key («Ajoelhar / levantar [K]»).
findings.evidence: Geoscape → Opções in landscape: the CONTROLOS section shows «Deslocar nas margens do ecrã» and «Roda do rato», and JOGO says «Pede um 2.º clique antes de disparar…». Long press on the kneel button in combat: tooltip «Ajoelhar / levantar K». Shots: persona/r4/ipad/shots/118_options.png, 045_longpress_kneel.png.
findings.fix: With isTouch() / matchMedia('(hover:none)'), hide the edge-scrolling and mouse-wheel rows (hud.opt.wheel around line 1651) and use a '.touch' variant: «Pede um 2.º toque…». In the tooltip, hide the .key element under @media (hover:none), as is already done for .btn .key.

findings.claim: In «Local da primeira base», rotating the iPad from landscape to portrait keeps the globe's old centre. The chosen site (the marker over Lisbon) ends up off-screen or behind the panel until you tap CENTRAR.
findings.evidence: New campaign → step 2 in landscape with the site at 38.7° N 9.1° O. Rotate to 834×1194: only the Atlantic and Canada are visible and there is no marker (shot persona/r4/ipad/shots/007_step2_portrait.png). After tapping CENTRAR, Portugal and the marker appear (008_step2_portrait_centrar.png).
findings.fix: On the resize/orientationchange handler of the site-picking scene, re-centre the view on the selected site (or keep the lat/lon centre while recomputing the area visible above the panel in portrait).

delights: The pinch on the globe now stays at maximum zoom, and two-finger drags work smoothly.
In portrait combat, «Reserva de UT» gets its own row under the actions, so «Fim do turno» no longer covers anything.
A long press on any HUD icon shows its name without triggering the action, so I finally know what each button does.
Renaming the base, the Skyranger («Águia») and a soldier («Marta Kato») with the virtual keyboard, where «Return» just saves and closes, feels natural.
Equipar in portrait is now laid out well: the soldier strip with horizontal scrolling, a large doll and the Armazém below. Tap the item, tap the destination, done.
The «Durante o turno alienígena» report now sits beside the squad list, readable, with an «Atacante» button to see who fired.
In portrait, the Ufopédia (large figure, then text) and Financiamento (one column) read like a well-made iPad app.
Fast loading: briefing to combat in 3–4 s, base in under a second, and no page errors in 75 minutes.
The «MOVIMENTO OCULTO… Toque para acelerar» banner and the «Toque (iPad)» section of Como Jogar show the game was thought out for touch.
Tapping the tactical map to move the camera works well, even in an alien base.
